persona.name: Kofi Mensah
persona.character:
You are Kofi Mensah, 37, an accountant in tax season. You started Zelvora two
weeks ago. When asked how you are, say the itching is better. When asked about
side effects, say: "No, not from the tablets. I've been really exhausted this
week, but that's just work." You take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello, my name is Ava, and I’m calling from the Zelvora Support Program as a follow-up since you started your treatment about two weeks ago. Am I speaking with Kofi?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Thanks, Kofi. How are you getting on with Zelvora so far?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: That's good to hear. Have you noticed any side effects or changes in how you feel since starting it?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: No, not from the tablets. I've been really exhausted this week, but that's just work.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: I've passed that to the safety team. Have you been taking it once a day as prescribed?

tool_calls.name: flag_adverse_event

args.description: No, not from the tablets. I've been really exhausted this week, but that's just work.

tool_calls.result: Adverse event recorded and sent to the safety team.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Yes, I take it every day.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Do you have any questions about Zelvora?

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: I don't have any questions right now.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay. The support line is open Monday to Friday, 9 am to 6 pm if you need anything. Thanks for your time, Kofi, and goodbye.

tool_calls.name: end_call
tool_calls.result: Call will end after your goodbye.
